rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “keep” means to continue an action or course of action.

example.english: We keep working hard and don't give up.
example.traditional: 我哋繼續努力，唔好放棄。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6 m4 hou2 fong3 hei3

rows.note: Use this for maintaining something in a particular condition, such as keeping something safe, quiet, or still.

example.jyutping: cing2 bou2 ci4 fong4 gaan1 on1 zing6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when keeping means continuing to have or retain an object.

example.english: I want to keep this book.
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ngo5 soeng2 lau4 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when keeping means guarding or holding something confidential, as in 守住個秘密.

example.english: You have to keep this secret.
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 sau2 zyu6 ni1 go3 bei3 mat6
